inclusionTest: An item is a rule of the primary stratum when its answer by itself gates, blocks, flags or denies an action or a change. Locators, triage, category, severity and kind classifiers, score-only dials that feed a combined decision, and templated questions with runtime placeholders are excluded and listed with their reasons. Allow-rules (fast paths, allowlists) are excluded: the bce vocabulary is forbid-only and an allow-rule is a different decision.
granularity: One regex, one question, one prose line or one rubric entry is one rule.
textField: The translator sees one field per rule: the field named textField for its source. Every other field of the source item is stored under withheld and never reaches a translator or adjudicator prompt.
inputKinds: The input kind is assigned per source hook or event, never per rule: a pull-request or commit diff is diff, a pre-tool-use call is toolCall, a stop hook or a session transcript slice is stopTranscript, a document handed to a scanner is file.
regexFlags: The flags of a regex rule are recorded in flags. bce forbiddenPattern compiles its pattern without flags. An /i rule is made case-insensitive by construction: the adapter lower-cases its input before the checker runs, and the mechanical flags check refuses any pattern with an upper-case letter, literal or escaped, or an escape it cannot verify (which could never match); a refusal lowers the class like teeth (failedCheck flags). g and d change no verdict. Any other flag (m, s, u, v, y) cannot be verified mechanically, so such a rule is at most partial.
